guarantees.claim: timer_limit is driven to the value of wait_timer_limit_i cast to TimerW bits (truncation/extension may occur).
prng_en_rand_d is assigned either rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW-2 -: 4] when aux_update is true, or {1'b0, prng_en_rand_q[3:1]} otherwise, implementing a refresh or shift-out choice.

assumptions.claim: EntropyOutputW must be ≥ 2, otherwise the slice rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW-2 -: 4] produces an invalid index.
assumptions.cond: always, as used in prng_en_rand_d assignment
assumptions.risk: Synthesis/simulation failure or mis-indexed read could load unintended bits for PRNG refresh, compromising entropy quality.

assumptions.claim: Signal prng_en_rand_q must be at least 4 bits wide to allow the extraction prng_en_rand_q[3:1].
assumptions.risk: Out-of-range select leads to synthesis error or incorrect shift-out data, breaking PRNG enable sequencing.

assumptions.claim: When aux_update is asserted, rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW-2 -: 4] must contain valid entropy.
assumptions.risk: prng_en_rand_d loads stale or predictable bits, undermining the PRNG's security properties.

uncertain_points.claim: If EntropyOutputW < 2, the slice rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW-2 -: 4] is invalid; legal parameterizations may not guarantee EntropyOutputW ≥ 2.
uncertain_points.risk: Indexing error could load garbage into prng_en_rand_d, directly compromising PRNG entropy refresh.

uncertain_points.claim: The shift operation {1'b0, prng_en_rand_q[3:1]} requires prng_en_rand_q width ≥ 4; there is no local check and the parameterization may not enforce this.
uncertain_points.risk: Synthesis error or bit-select out of range could corrupt the shift-out logic, affecting PRNG enable timing.

uncertain_points.claim: TimerW'(wait_timer_limit_i) may truncate the input if wait_timer_limit_i is wider than TimerW, resulting in a smaller timer limit than expected.
uncertain_points.risk: Shorter timer could accelerate entropy state transitions beyond intended design, weakening entropy accumulation.

uncertain_points.claim: The offset EntropyOutputW-2 used to select 4 bits from rand_data_q is arbitrary; the rationale for subtracting 2 is unclear and may be a design-intent error.
uncertain_points.risk: If the offset is incorrect, prng_en_rand_d may receive non-entropy bits, defeating the refresh mechanism.
